Your notes so far

  • round 1: I want the buttons to only be 5mm thck and I want their diameter to be equal to the height of the deck, otherwise move forward with the design
  • round 2: I want the buttons flush to the surface of the volume and i don't want anthing protruding
  • round 2: owner (gap answers to the flush push-back): knob = height - 4; feet on the underside are fine. Also: I also want as few screws as possible
  • round 3: the cutout doesn't need to surround the whole dial. Have a small cutout for the encoder and the button will slide over the protruding encoder
  • round 4: restart the design from this base (flacmn_deck_layout.svg, commit e22ecdf)
  • round 5: I no longer want the front to mount separately. I want the bent portion to be made up of the front face in the center, and the sides, top and bottom bending backwards. Then I want the rear plate to mount to the rear using m3
  • round 6: I want there to be 4 m3 screws to enter from the back face and I want the back plate to have no bending, add folded tabs to the top and bottom pieces
  • round 7: designer correction after build: the folded tabs put the nuts 0.5 mm nearer the top and floor than the back plate's screw holes; move the holes to match (owner approved round 7: 'Approved, build it')
  • round 8: Make caps 13 mm thick (so the 15 mm PEC11R-4215F shaft ends at the cap face)
  • round 9: see the updated layout svg. I want to add the mn logo to the front as cut holes / make sure it is centered horizontally on the small knob (answers: smaller dots, Ø1.8; rear rectangles are only drawing)
  • round 10: make the knobs thinner as well, cut the encoder chaft if needed (answer: 8 mm)

The design

A · Folded shell with back tabs + flat back plate

Round 7, from the owner's layout at true scale (241 x 88.5 x 100.5). One folded shell: the front face in the centre with the top, floor and both sides folded back from it, and two tabs folded in at the back of the top and two at the back of the floor (8 folds). A flat back plate (no folds) takes four ISO 4762 M3 x 8 from the back face into clinch nuts in the tabs. The 5in DSI screen is taped behind the front face; both encoders nut into it and the Ø57 x 8 and Ø35 x 8 caps sit proud on the shafts. The Pi + DAC sit on the floor at the back right; USB and Ethernet cords thread out through three cut-outs in the back plate.

Mechanism
flat back plate screwed into the shell's tabs from behind; encoders nutted into the front face; Pi on standoffs on the floor; caps pushed on
Layout
screen left, knobs right on the front; Pi flat at the back right, sockets to the back, USB/Ethernet into the free space; cords out the back panel
Load path
knobs -> front face -> shell -> feet -> shelf
Process
laser-cut flat; shell 8 hand folds on perforated lines (UNTESTED recipe); back plate flat; clinch nuts pressed

Flat pattern: Shell (front, top, floor, sides)

8 folds by hand, 5052-H32_1.0. Untested folds: no coupon has held for this recipe yet.

Flat pattern: Back plate (flat, removable)

0 folds by hand, 5052-H32_1.0.
